jobs.title: Staff GRC Analyst
jobs.description: Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson. Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey. We are looking for a Staff GRC Analyst who will be the bridge between technical engineering teams and external auditors. The role will work closely with Security, Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal, going beyond checklist compliance by examining technical configurations, validating data flows, and helping build automated safeguards across a multi-cloud environment. This is a key role reporting to our Director of GRC and can be based remotely in the United States. This is a technical role that will independently own their area of responsibility, improve existing approaches, and advise stakeholders as new security requirements are adopted. What you will be doing: Partner with Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams to translate FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, CMMC, NIST SP 800-53/800-171, SOC 2, ISO, and other security requirements into actionable technical controls and implementation standards across AWS and Azure. jobs.title: Senior Legal Partner
jobs.description: About the Role A German-qualified senior legal partner will help shape the growth of an AI-enabled legal services business. You will bring an established client practice to a technology-driven platform, continue advising clients, and help build a scalable model for recurring legal work. What You'll Do Help guide the firm's growth and contribute to its next stage of development. Continue serving your existing clients while transitioning suitable recurring matters to an AI agent platform. Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market relationships. Identify and develop cross-selling opportunities in commercial and compliance legal services. Work with the founding team to improve workflows and automate repeatable legal work. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level. German-qualified Volljurist and admitted Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally held, portable book of business worth at least €1 million, supported by a diversified client network. Strong relationships in private equity, venture capital, or the mid-market, with potential to support commercial and compliance work. Experience with recurring, automatable matters such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory work. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI products, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows to automation. Interest in an AI-enabled legal services model, meaningful equity participation, and a feasible transition of client work. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. The role includes meaningful equity participation. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Based in Berlin, Germany. The role may be on-site or remote within Germany. jobs.description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out. You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. jobs.title: Sr. Compliance Associate Lead - Market Surveillance
jobs.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them. We are hiring a Senior Compliance Associate Lead to take on our more complex casework, own an area of the surveillance programme, and act as a senior point of reference for the analysts around them. The opportunity Take the more complex investigations end to end, including those that begin as a referral rather than an alert, and present conclusions to senior compliance stakeholders and the business. Act as a senior reviewer for colleagues' work, and a point of escalation for judgement calls on how an alert or a case should be treated. Contribute to threshold and model reviews, recalibrating detection as trading behaviour, products and market structure change. Support surveillance platform and tooling work, including setting out what detection needs to achieve and validating that it does. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
